headline: Crypto Industry in Kazakhstan Will Become the Next Direction of the New Economy
summary: Deputy Prime Minister Zhaslan Madiyev told a government meeting how many points of sale across Kazakhstan already accept cryptocurrency payments. He framed crypto as a direction of the new economy.
why: Government policy on crypto payments and licensing shapes adoption and the regulatory environment for digital asset firms. Kazakhstan has been positioning itself as a crypto-friendly jurisdiction.
